items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And there was a piano player, Sammy Williams, and Othello Hepburn, he was on base and I played drums.

ctx.x: What did George McCaskel play -- alto or tenor?

Alto, he played alto. George, and the other alto player was a guy named Mr. Higgs, who was also a schoolteacher in Miami at the time. Mr. Higgs, yeah, he played the other alto saxophone with the band.
And there was a piano player, Sammy Williams, and Othello Hepburn, he was on base and I played drums.
